Add split cluster labels to SpatialExperiment colData

Source: R/R-spe.R
add_split_to_spe.Rd

This function adds the labels of a split cluster (e.g., `C2_1`, `C2_2`) to the colData of a SpatialExperiment object. Labels are matched by `spot_id`, whatever the order of the rows. The original cluster column is not changed.

Usage

add_split_to_spe(spe, split, split_col = "cluster_split", erase = FALSE)

Arguments

spe

A SpatialExperiment object from which the split data.frame was derived.

split

A data.frame with one row per spot and columns `spot_id` and `split_col`, typically the output of [split_clusters()].

split_col

Character. Name of the column of `split` holding the labels, also used as the name of the new colData column. Default is `"cluster_split"`.

erase

Logical. If `TRUE`, replace a pre-existing column of that name. If `FALSE` (default), the object is returned unchanged with a message if the column already exists.

Value

The SpatialExperiment object with updated colData.

Details

Spots of `spe` that are absent from `split` get `NA`. It is an error if a spot of `split` is absent from `spe`, or if identifiers are duplicated.

Spot identifiers of `spe` are taken from the `spot_id` column of `colData` if present, otherwise from `colnames(spe)`.

Examples

data("visium_simulated_spe", package = "Battlefield")
spe <- visium_simulated_spe
df <- data.frame(
  spot_id = colnames(spe),
  x = SpatialExperiment::spatialCoords(spe)[, 1],
  y = SpatialExperiment::spatialCoords(spe)[, 2],
  cluster = SummarizedExperiment::colData(spe)$cluster
)
split <- split_clusters(df, "1", min_size = 5)
spe <- add_split_to_spe(spe, split)
table(spe$cluster, spe$cluster_split)
#>    
#>       1   2   3   4   5
#>   1  81   0   0   0   0
#>   2   0  47   0   0   0
#>   3   0   0 428   0   0
#>   4   0   0   0 411   0
#>   5   0   0   0   0  33
